# Vorrel Cloud

Vorrel Cloud is a SaaS company specializing in dental clinic scheduling and billing solutions, with a focus on optimizing chair utilization, managing insurance claims, and running patient recall campaigns. Our flagship product, ClaimTrackr, automates insurance claim submissions and provides real-time monitoring of approval status, significantly reducing administrative overhead for dental billing services.

ClaimTrackr is tailored primarily for dental billing services that handle multiple dental offices seeking to streamline their insurance workflows. Currently, over 150 dental offices across the country rely on ClaimTrackr to speed up claim processing and improve cash flow. Since our launch in 2021, Vorrel Cloud has completed a $4.2M seed round led by Crestline Ventures and achieved 120% year-over-year revenue growth.

Our team comprises 12 full-time employees including dental industry veterans, software engineers, and compliance experts. The product roadmap includes expanding recall campaign automation and integrating direct scheduling features.

Vorrel Cloud faces competition from established players like DentiManage and ClaimStream but differentiates itself through real-time claim status monitoring and ease of integration. Key open risks include navigating evolving insurance regulations and maintaining data security amid increasing cyber threats. The company is actively investing in compliance and infrastructure to mitigate these risks.
